elevate.tooltip: Reopens WinCare with administrator rights (UAC) from a verified copy under Program Files. Needed for actions that require administrator.
elevate.confirm:
WinCare will ask for administrator permission (UAC) and reopen from a verified copy under Program Files. This window will close.

Continue?
elevate.cancelled: Elevation was not started (UAC cancelled or blocked by organization policy). Nothing was changed.
elevate.not-release: Running from source: automatic elevation only works with a verified release. Open PowerShell as administrator and start WinCare again.
